Why did Krishna forgive a hundred insults? As the story goes, a prince named Shishupala was born with a third eye and extra arms. A voice from the sky said, the one whose touch makes them disappear will one day end his life.
When Krishna held the baby, they disappeared. His mother begged, please spare my son. So Krishna promised, I will forgive him a hundred times.

Years later, at a royal ceremony, Shishupala stood up and insulted Krishna. Again. And again. Krishna kept counting, calmly. Ninety eight. Ninety nine. One hundred. Wait, what happened at one hundred and one?
Krishna raised his finger, and the Sudarshan Chakra flew. That's why we say, God's patience is endless, but it has a limit. Comment one hundred if you knew this.
